transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because people keep acting like I'm just imagining things. But I'm not. I know the hospital people and... well, some folks from the agency, they've been watching our house. And checking up on my cleaning routes at work. They're just trying to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Have you ever heard any voices or sounds that other people didn't seem to hear, when no one was around?

I... yes. Sometimes. 

When the house is quiet... I hear a woman. She's usually near the kitchen window. She tells me things I need to do. Like... checking the locks, or moving his pills to a different spot. It's... it's just as clear as if she were standing right next to me.
Around when did you first start hearing that voice?
I suppose... it's been a while. Maybe... about 11 months now. Since the voice started. And... the people watching, too. It's been about that long.
Over these past 11 months, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or unable to enjoy things?
No... not really. I don't think so. I just... I go to my cleaning jobs, and I come home. I haven't felt sad, if that's what you mean. Just busy.
Have you ever been diagnosed with any medical or neurological conditions?
No... I don't think so. I haven't had any... major health problems like that. Just regular doctor visits.
Do you drink alcohol, use any recreational drugs, or take any over-the-counter medications?
No... I don't drink. And I don't use drugs. I don't really take any medicines from the store, either. Just... no.
How often do you hear this woman's voice?

I don't know exactly... just, even when the house is quiet, I hear her. Usually over near the kitchen window. She just... she tells me to check the locks. Or to move his pills. It's... it's as clear as if she's standing right there. That's... that's really it.
